The authoritative branch reconciler does so and pins ubuntu-24.04 plus Python 3.13.15, but supernova-pr-target-admission.yml, supernova-comment-admission.yml and supernova-open-pr-reconciler.yml use statuses:write, run the trusted reconcile_open_prs.py admission authority, select mutable ubuntu-latest and Python '3.13', install only the wheel lock, and never invoke assert_validator_environment.py. The frozen privileged-workflow regression checks the mutable '3.13' selector but does not require the environment assertion. These paths can therefore publish the three admission contexts under an environment that the frozen contract says must fail closed on exact runner/Python/Git drift.
